import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Top products by total revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
top_products = product_revenue.head(10)
colors1 = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(top_products)))
bars1 = axes[0, 0].barh(top_products.index, top_products.values, color=colors1)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
for i, (product, revenue) in enumerate(zip(top_products.index, top_products.values)):
    axes[0, 0].text(revenue + max(top_products.values)*0.005, i, f'${revenue:,.0f}', 
                   va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by age group
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values()
colors2 = plt.cm.Pastel1(np.linspace(0, 1, len(age_group_sales)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(age_group_sales.values, labels=age_group_sales.index, 
                                          autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors2, startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)

# 3. Average transaction value by payment method
payment_avg = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].mean().sort_values()
colors3 = plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, len(payment_avg)))
bars3 = axes[0, 2].bar(range(len(payment_avg)), payment_avg.values, color=colors3)
axes[0, 2].set_xticks(range(len(payment_avg)))
axes[0, 2].set_xticklabels(payment_avg.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Average Transaction by Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(payment_avg.values):
    axes[0, 2].text(i, v + max(payment_avg.values)*0.01, f'${v:.2f}', 
                   ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in revenue
takeaway_revenue = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors4 = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges2, texts2, autotexts2 = axes[1, 0].pie(takeaway_revenue.values, labels=takeaway_labels, 
                                            autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors4, startangle=90)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Revenue: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts2:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)

# 5. Hourly sales pattern
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[1, 1].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
               color='#6A0572', markersize=8)
axes[1, 1].fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3, color='#6A0572')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Hourly Sales Pattern', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for hour, revenue in zip(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values):
    axes[1, 1].text(hour, revenue + max(hourly_sales.values)*0.02, f'${revenue:,.0f}', 
                   ha='center', fontsize=8)

# 6. Size preference by product
size_product_pivot = df.pivot_table(index='product', columns='size', values='total', 
                                   aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
top_5_products = size_product_pivot.sum(axis=1).nlargest(5).index
size_product_top = size_product_pivot.loc[top_5_products]
size_product_top.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 2], width=0.8, 
                     color=['#FFD166', '#06D6A0', '#118AB2'])
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Size Preference for Top 5 Products', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].legend(title='Size', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
